title: resourceCommand
responsibility: Runs an admitted command with inherited streams and bounded lifetime, retaining ownership-aware cleanup failures.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.args
inputs.description: The command and its arguments: element 0 is the executable, run in the current working directory (process.cwd()), and the rest are passed to it as its arguments. On macOS, agent-test jobs run under taskpolicy -b at nice +10 or their already lower inherited priority. An empty array rejects with 'A managed command is required after --' before anything starts.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.context
inputs.description: The admitted resource context: `env` is the environment the command runs with and also selects the resources home through HARNESS_RESOURCES_HOME; `id` names the log file `<id>.log` in that home's logs directory; `track(pid)` is called with the process id once the command has spawned. If `track` throws, the command is halted and the call resolves to 1 instead of rejecting with that error.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal: if it is aborted while the command runs, the command is halted and cleaned up, and the call then rejects with the signal's abort reason; a signal that is already aborted rejects before the command starts. Without it, the command runs until it exits or reaches timeoutMs.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Time limit for the command in milliseconds, defaulting to 21600000 (six hours); when it elapses, the command and what it started are stopped and the call resolves to a nonzero status. It must be a finite number above 0 and at most 2147483647 (the native timer limit), otherwise the call rejects with 'Invalid managed command timeout' before anything starts.

outputs.name: resourceCommand
outputs.description: Resolves to 0 only when the command exits with 0, does not time out, and its cleanup leaves no surviving process and no unknown state; otherwise it resolves to the command's nonzero exit code, or to 1 when that code is 0 or null.

errors.name: InvalidResourceCommandInputError
errors.description: Rejects with an Error whose message is 'Invalid managed command timeout', before anything starts, when timeoutMs is not a finite number, is 0 or less, or is above 2147483647.

errors.name: InvalidResourceCommandInputError
errors.description: Rejects with an Error whose message is 'A managed command is required after --', before anything starts, when args is empty.

errors.name: signal.reason
errors.description: Rejects with the signal's abort reason, unchanged, when the signal is aborted: before anything starts if it was already aborted, otherwise after cleanup has run and the log is written.

errors.name: runIsolated failure
errors.description: Rejects with a non-abort error from runIsolated: a synchronous error from spawning the `sh` wrapper, such as an invalid argument, before the command starts, or a file-system error from creating or writing the log after the command has ended. In both cases no exit status is returned.
